let cursor = 0;
const saved = [];
const reader = { async read() { return cursor < 3 ? ++cursor : null; } };
async function main() {
  for (let item; (item = await reader.read()) !== null; ) {
    saved.push(item);
  }
  if (saved.join(',') !== '1,2,3') throw Error(String(saved));
  console.log(JSON.stringify({saved}));
}
main();
